subject: KnowNo status: calibration reproduced, ambiguity-mix caveat for our workflows
body:
Hi Priya, Ivo,

Status. The May 8 milestone closed on time — we reproduced the released calibration flow on the demo setting and get the expected behavior: prediction sets grow exactly when the instruction is ambiguous, and the conformal guarantee holds at our 90% target completion level on held-out tasks.

Our own calibration set now stands at 1,150 tasks drawn from real (anonymized) workflow traces. Early threshold tuning shows a wrinkle the paper's settings didn't stress: our ambiguity distribution is lumpy — about 20% of tasks are numeric-quantity ambiguities where the option generator produces near-duplicate plans, inflating prediction sets and triggering unnecessary help requests. Farah's dedup pass in the option harness cuts the spurious help-rate from 23% to 14% at the same coverage target.

Risk: if the workflow's task mix shifts after calibration, the guarantee quietly weakens. We'll propose a monthly recalibration job as part of the ship criteria.

Vera
